'''Sib Canay''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] conspirator during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Canay with the help of the Separatists hired the the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] and his [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Unidentified Gotal bounty hunter/Legends|accomplice]] to kidnap the [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida|Papanoida's]] daughters in order to coerce him into aligning [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]] with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]].

==Biography==
[[File:Sib_Canay.png|thumb|left|200px|Sib Canay negotiating with chairman [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]].]]
Sib Canay was a most influential [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] at the time of the [[Blockade of Pantora/Legends|Blockade of Pantora]] during the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] crisis after the [[Battle of Orto Plutonia/Legends|Battle]] of [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was in [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]], legalized under the pretense that Pantora had to repay it's debt to the Federation, and with no motivation to join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. He was defeated after Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and Senator Chuchi came aboard his ship to rescue Chairman Papanoida's daughter, who was being held hostage. After the rescue, he and a platoon of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] confronted the Padawan and her compatriots and attempted to arrest them. Tano defeated the droids and was about to arrest Sib Canay when one of his Commanders arrived with a troop of [[Neimoidian Gunnery Battalion|Neimoidian guards]]. Canay confessed to his crimes and surrendered to Tano, after agreeing to remove the blockade of Pantora.

==Behind the scenes==
Sib Canay was voiced by [[Corey Burton]], who also provides the voices for [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida|Papanoida]].
